- Salary: $130,000-$180,000 per year + 0.25%-1% equity
- Experience: 3-6 years production software with strong backend depth; TypeScript, Node.js or Bun, PostgreSQL and Redis/queues/background workers; multi-tenant APIs, pipelines and distributed-systems debugging; product judgment and comfort with enterprise customers
- Schedule: 9am-9pm, Monday-Friday (9-9-5)
- Visa sponsorship: Listed; individual route and eligibility need confirmation

Full JD: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ifFNwsmFRz9FD0sUvX7Tm5oFQrpi8lOw/view?usp=drivesdk&authuser=hari.m%40lookoutai.io
